# Copilot instructions

Review pull requests per `.agents/docs/code-review.md` and the role contract in
`.ai/agents/reviewer.md`.

Project rules live in `AGENTS.md`; current behavior lives in `specs/`, and procedures live in
`runbook/`. Report findings only: file, line, problem, fix. Run both linters for C++/SQL changes.

Instructions about the review's format or its overview comment are
[unsupported](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/tutorials/customize-code-review#unsupported-instruction-types)
and do not belong here.
